name: Nago (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Nago city emblem in green: a ring open at the top with a stylised angular device.
history: Municipal flag of Nago, a city in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 8 August 1972.

features.role: Nago city emblem — a ring open at the top with a stylised angular device
